events.headline: Mercury launches Agent Controls
events.summary: Introduced permissions, approvals, spending limits and activity tracking for connected AI agents, with the ability to disconnect agents.

events.headline: Mercury reinvents Treasury
events.summary: Redesigned Treasury around business spending, combining personalized investment recommendations with U.S. Treasury bond ladders and adapting portfolios.

events.headline: Introducing Mercury Payroll
events.summary: Launched integrated employee and contractor payroll, benefits, retirement plans and payroll tax/compliance administration.

events.headline: Take action on your Mercury account from ChatGPT and Claude
events.summary: Enabled customers to initiate money movements, pay recipients and categorize transactions from ChatGPT or Claude, with approval required.

events.headline: All your accounts, connected
events.summary: Enabled linking multiple Mercury accounts for direct transfers and scheduled auto-transfers.

events.headline: Send real-time payments with the Mercury API
events.summary: Added API-based real-time payments, including nights, weekends and holidays, for eligible Business and Personal accounts provided through Column, N.A.

events.headline: Authorize wire drawdowns for payroll
events.summary: Enabled payroll-provider wire drawdowns from Mercury accounts provided through both Column, N.A. and Choice Financial Group.

And your portfolio adapts as your business spends, so you’re maximizing your yield with less work.
